name: live-db-pilot
displayName: Live DB Pilot & Local Database Explorer
description: Real-time inspection and execution for local databases. Features an embedded zero-dependency SQLite MCP server (using Node.js 22 native node:sqlite), schema introspector, migration verifier, and SQL query optimizer for SQLite, PostgreSQL, and MySQL.
suggestedPrompts: Inspect the schema and list all tables and indexes in my local database file
Run an EXPLAIN query on this SQL statement and suggest an optimal composite index
Test this database migration on a temporary cloned database before applying it to production
